question: What experiential results arise from the preceding visualization practice?
premises: The practitioner plays with various enjoyments.
The practitioner becomes of the form of wish.
Both results follow from the meditation.
inference: Through this meditation one enjoys various pleasures and attains a wish-fulfilling form.
uncertainties: icchārūpa may mean a form according to wish or a form of will.
plain_english: He plays with various enjoyments and becomes of the form of wish.
